messages:
maria: New HW partner EdgeBox wants per-minute metering but uploads gzipped offline batches up to 48h late. Need device_id->customer mapping, SKU names, HMAC verification, and a reconciliation playbook. blockers?

sarah: We can ingest late batches. Requirements: batch_id & event_id dedupe, TTL for dedupe, and clear status codes (401 sig fail, 400 bad payload, 200 dup ignored).

raj: EdgeBox proposes SKUs: edge_minutes_v1 (consumption) and edge_seat (entitlement). Sample payload: {batch_id, org_id, device_id, events[{event_id, device_ts, seconds}], seat_count, signature}. They will gzip and send up to 10k events.

oliver: Ops notes: verify HMAC with shared secret; dedupe TTL prod=30d/staging=14d; convert device_ts to UTC on ingest; mark affected invoice windows "dirty" and re-aggregate on late arrival.

maria: Policy: attribute usage by event device_ts (UTC) and bill by plan effective at event time; prorate if plan boundary crosses event timestamp. Chargeable unit = round up to nearest whole minute; persist raw seconds in audit logs.

sarah: I'll update API contract to accept optional plan_id and plan_effective_ts to make reconciliation deterministic. Acceptance tests: duplicate batch ignored, signature failure -> 401, late batch triggers re-aggregation and audit diff.

raj: I'll run secret exchange and onboarding call Tue 10am PT. @billing-bot can you provision sandbox org and staging key?

billing-bot: Sandbox org created edgebox-sbx-003, staging key sbx-edge-CHARLIE, sandbox plan edgebox-staging-30d. :white_check_mark:

maria: Next steps recap: sarah spec+tests, oliver add re-agg alert and runbook, raj secret exchange/onboard, we'll verify after 3 sample batches. Thanks!
